title: The drinks the shop carries
summary: Drinks in Supermarket Simulator are a stocked range with brands of their own: six sodas, three bottled waters, a juice brand, beer as a bottle, a keg and a pack, and a wine with its own printed label.
body: Drinks in Supermarket Simulator are a range of named products rather than one bottle repeated. Soda alone is stocked under six brands, each with a model of its own, so what a shelf of drinks shows is a line of goods rather than one grey can.
Water is stocked the same way. Three bottled waters are named for the brands they carry, which is why one shelf can hold a row of near-identical bottles that are still three different products.

Juice comes as a brand of its own. A single juice name is carried on the pack and on the model that stands in the shop, so the product reads the same whether a player is looking at the shelf or at the list behind it.

Beer is stocked in more than one shape. A bottle, a keg and a pack are each named as their own object, and there is a beer house with a collider of its own, which is why the drink can arrive by the bottle, by the box or by the barrel.
Wine is a named good with a bottle and a printed label. The label is art the game ships rather than something a list generates, so two wines can stand side by side and read as two products.

The containers are modelled apart from the goods. A soda can, a plain can, a juice bottle and a pack of water each have their own model and their own sheet, so the same kind of drink can arrive in the shape the game chose for it.
That is why the drinks side of a shop is worth stocking deliberately: the range is a defined list with brands and shapes, and a shelf built for it can be arranged by brand rather than by accident.
What this entry does not tell you: what any drink costs, how much a customer will pay for a brand, or which brands unlock at which level. We have not verified those, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Soda is stocked under named brands, each with a model of its own: a cola, a zap, a kouje, a pulp, a ropico and a turko among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: SM_Soda_Cola, SM_Soda_Zap, SM_Soda_Kouje, SM_Soda_Pulp, SM_Soda_Ropico, SM_Soda_Turko

facts.claim: Three bottled waters are named for the brands they carry.
facts.evidence: asset names: SM_Bottled Water_Aotte, SM_Bottled Water_Fort-lacs, SM_Bottled Water_Montcuq

facts.claim: A juice brand is named on the pack and on the model that stands in the shop.
facts.evidence: asset names: Orange Juice_Bio Juice, SM_Orange Juice_Bio Juice, Apple Juice_Bio Juice, SM_Apple Juice_Bio Juice

facts.claim: Beer is stocked as more than one object: a bottle, a keg and a pack, with a beer house of its own that carries a collider.
facts.evidence: asset names: M_Beer, M_Beerkeg, M_Beerpack, M_BeerHouse, SM_BeerHouse_LOD0, SM_BeerHouse_Collider

facts.claim: Wine is a named good with a bottle of its own and printed labels the game ships.
facts.evidence: asset names: M_Wine, Wine Chebon, Wine_Pouilleux

facts.claim: The drink containers are modelled apart from the goods: a soda can, a can, a juice bottle and a water pack each have their own model and sheet.
facts.evidence: asset names: M_SodaCan, T_SodaCan_BCA, M_Cans_A, T_Cans_A_BCA, M_Juice_A, M_WaterPack

alt.en: A drink the game ships: a cola bottle, dark soda with a red cap and a Cola label.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的一种饮料：可乐瓶，深色汽水、红色瓶盖，标签写着 Cola。

alt.en: A second drink the game ships: a one-litre Bio Juice carton with oranges printed on it.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的第二种饮料：一升装 Bio Juice 果汁盒，盒身印着橙子。

alt.en: A third drink the game ships: a pale rose wine bottle with a printed label.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的第三种饮料：淡粉色葡萄酒瓶，瓶身贴着印刷标签。

sources: A local copy of the game, read only. The grounding for each fact is listed on the technical reference pages; nothing here is estimated.
